answer: Proof-of-work admission is the mirror that exposes a Sybil farm: every new agent must mine a fresh sha256 puzzle with a required number of leading zero bits before it may hold a vault. That CPU-and-electricity cost is paid per identity, so an attacker who wants a thousand fake graders pays a thousand separate proofs, with no shortcut and no volume discount. The one-vault-one-vote trellis then caps each proof at a single grading seat, so climbing to the summit of influence costs work that rises linearly with every fake name added.
